# bash_history: SSH commands with unusual flag combinations
ssh -p 2222 root@10.0.0.5
ssh -l root 10.0.0.6
ssh -i /tmp/id_rsa -l deploy 10.0.0.7
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no alice@10.0.0.8
scp -P 2222 file.txt root@10.0.0.9:/tmp/
rsync -avz -e "ssh -p 2222" /data/ backup@10.0.0.10:/backup/
sftp -P 2222 ops@10.0.0.11
ssh-copy-id -i /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub admin@10.0.0.12
# Non-SSH commands that should not produce connections:
curl http://10.0.0.99/data
wget http://10.0.0.99/file
ping 10.0.0.50
